body.x: Adonit (www.adonit.net), a maker of digital pens, introduced JOT PRO and JOT MINI at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.JOT PRO is a digital pen made for use with iPad, iPhone, Android, Windows, and most other touchscreen devices. The Precision Disc creates an exact contact point with the screen to write exactly where users place it. The cushion tip dampens screen contact for fluid, quiet writing. The solid aluminum and steel body is built for quality feel and function.JOT MINI is a mini-sized pen with a built-in clip for convenience. Jot Mini has the same function as Jot Pro in a shorter build. It is designed to be used with devices with smaller screen size, where precise pointing is needed.
